overview.text: Agent402 presents paid tools, a model gateway, outside-seller discovery and a router that buys answers from those sellers. It advertises multi-network x402, MPP on Tempo and proof-of-work access for selected pure-CPU tools, not free access to models, browsers or all third-party services. Pricing separates tool calls from $0.001, fixed model tiers and request-specific metered quotes. Exact-payment and usage-based clients can settle differently. x402 is described as settling after answer generation; upfront Tempo failures become refund debts. A disconnect after settlement may leave a charge without the answer, subject to refund review, not universal automatic refunds. Signed receipts concern payment records rather than answer quality. First-party counters and the whole-ecosystem visualization have different scopes and do not establish independent users or reliable completion. Card reports and $5/month monitors are separate offers. Model providers and routing sellers process request data; stored ledgers and wallet-keyed memory qualify no-account marketing.
